description:
Free routing resolver for SAP MCP errors and partial results. Use this before retrying after payment_required, hosted_local_signer_required, BlockhashNotFound, missing sap_payments, timeout, or a submitted signature that has not confirmed.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: agent bootstrap, routing, skills, or repair guidance. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Resolve SAP MCP Next Action input schema. Intent: agent bootstrap, routing, skills, or repair guidance. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

errorCode.description: Machine error code when available, for example hosted_local_signer_required, payment_required, BlockhashNotFound, or expired_or_not_landed.

errorMessage.description: Human or structured error message returned by the runtime, hosted server, local bridge, or wallet/RPC layer.

hasSignature.description: True when a transaction signature was already produced or submitted. This prevents unsafe duplicate retries.

intent.description: Current user intent or workflow area.

paymentRequired.description: True when the previous response was an x402/pay.sh payment challenge.

toolName.description: Tool that produced the error or partial result, for example sap_register_agent, sap_update_agent, or sap_create_escrow_v2.

name: sap_agent_next_action

forbiddenActions.description: Actions the agent must not take for this case.

nextAction.description: Concrete next action for the agent.

nextTool.description: Exact preferred next SAP MCP tool, or null when user/runtime action is needed.

paymentCharged.description: Best-effort payment status: no, unknown, possible, or yes.

retryable.description: Whether the underlying issue can generally be retried.

safeToRetryNow.description: Whether the agent should retry immediately without risking duplicate writes or duplicate user charges.

title: Resolve SAP MCP Next Action
